words.example: In indirect transmission, germs spread through a dirty tool or doorknob.
words.exampleTranslation: 间接传播时，病菌通过不干净的工具或门把手传播。

evidence.quote: Indirect transmission (in-dih-REKT trans-MISH-uhn) occurs through contact with an intermediate contaminated object, such as a razor, extractor, nipper
Doorknobs, phones, food-preparation surfaces, or your implements at work are all possible vectors of indirect transmission

words.example: In airborne transmission, tiny dry particles with germs hang in the air.
words.exampleTranslation: 空气传播时，带着病菌的小而干的颗粒会悬浮在空气中。

evidence.quote: In airborne transmission, the particles are much smaller and dryer, so they hang in the air longer

words.example: A contagious disease, like a cold, spreads from person to person.
words.exampleTranslation: 传染性疾病（例如感冒）会人传人。

evidence.quote: When a disease is capable of being spread from one person to another, it is said to be a contagious disease
contagious diseases that prevent a beauty professional from servicing a client are the common cold

words.example: Too much contact with products at work can cause an occupational disease.
words.exampleTranslation: 工作中过多接触产品可能导致职业病。

evidence.quote: Illnesses resulting from conditions associated with employment, such as prolonged and repeated overexposure to certain products or ingredients.

words.example: Nonpathogenic bacteria are harmless; some help make yogurt.
words.exampleTranslation: 非致病性细菌是无害的，有些还能帮助制作酸奶。

evidence.quote: Most bacteria are nonpathogenic (nahn-path-uh-JEN-ik); in other words, they are harmless organisms that may perform useful functions.
nonpathogenic organisms are used to make yogurt, cheese, and some medicines

words.example: Inflammation shows as redness, heat, pain, or swelling.
words.exampleTranslation: 炎症表现为发红、发热、疼痛或肿胀。

evidence.quote: Inflammation is characterized by redness, heat, pain, and/or swelling.

words.example: Immunity is your body's power to fight off germs.
words.exampleTranslation: 免疫是身体抵抗病菌的能力。

evidence.quote: Immunity (im-YOO-net-ee) refers to the ability of the body to
resist and destroy pathogens and respond to infection.

words.example: Mycobacterium infections are linked to pedicure bowls, so disinfect every bowl.
words.exampleTranslation: 分枝杆菌感染与足浴盆有关，所以每个足浴盆都要消毒。

evidence.quote: it has been linked to disfiguring infections associated particularly with pedicure bowls
it is important to protect your clients by properly disinfecting all implements and bowls

words.example: HIV and hepatitis are bloodborne pathogens carried in blood.
words.exampleTranslation: HIV 和肝炎是存在于血液中的血源性病原体。

evidence.quote: Disease-causing microorganisms that are carried in the body by blood or body fluids, such as hepatitis and HIV, are called bloodborne pathogens

words.example: A biofilm is a sticky layer of germs, like slime in drains.
words.exampleTranslation: 生物膜是一层黏黏的微生物，就像下水道里的黏液。

evidence.quote: Biofilms (BY-o-films) are colonies of microorganisms that adhere to environmental surfaces
slime in drains are examples of visible environmental biofilms

words.example: Ringworm is a skin infection caused by a fungus, not a worm.
words.exampleTranslation: 癣是一种由真菌引起的皮肤感染，不是虫。

evidence.quote: Ringworm (RING-wurm), a fungal infection of the skin that appears in circular lesions

words.example: Scabies is caused by the itch mite, which digs under the skin.
words.exampleTranslation: 疥疮是由疥螨引起的，疥螨会钻到皮肤下面。

evidence.quote: Scabies (SKAY-beez) is a contagious skin disease caused by the itch mite, which burrows under the skin.

words.example: Sterilizing kills all germs, even bacterial spores.
words.exampleTranslation: 灭菌能杀死所有微生物，连细菌芽孢也能杀死。

evidence.quote: Sterilizing is the process that destroys all microbial life, including spores, generally with the use of an autoclave.

words.example: Disinfecting does not kill bacterial spores; sterilizing does.
words.exampleTranslation: 消毒杀不死细菌芽孢，灭菌才能杀死。

evidence.quote: This process, however, is not effective against bacterial spores.
Sterilizing is the process that destroys all microbial life, including spores

words.example: Contact time is how long the disinfectant must stay wet.
words.exampleTranslation: 接触时间是指消毒剂必须在表面保持湿润的时间。

evidence.quote: contact time (the time as listed on the product label required for the disinfectant to be visibly moist to be effective against pathogens)

words.example: Dilute a concentrate by adding it to water, not water to it.
words.exampleTranslation: 稀释浓缩液时，要把浓缩液倒进水里，而不是把水倒进浓缩液。

evidence.quote: Add disinfectant to water when diluting (rather than adding water to a disinfectant) to prevent foaming

words.example: A tuberculocidal disinfectant kills the germ that causes tuberculosis.
words.exampleTranslation: 杀结核菌消毒剂能杀死引起结核病的细菌。

evidence.quote: are proven to kill the bacterium that causes tuberculosis

words.example: Phenolic disinfectants kill tuberculosis germs but can hurt skin and eyes.
words.exampleTranslation: 酚类消毒剂能杀死结核菌，但会伤害皮肤和眼睛。

evidence.quote: Phenolic disinfectants (fi-NOH-lik dis-in-FEK-tents) are powerful tuberculocidal disinfectants
have a very high pH, and can damage the skin and eyes

words.example: Isopropyl alcohol cleans skin, but it does not disinfect tools.
words.exampleTranslation: 异丙醇能清洁皮肤，但不能给工具消毒。

evidence.quote: Isopropyl alcohol is effective in cleaning the skin
Alcohol is not a disinfectant for surfaces or implements and should be used only as a cleaner or antiseptic.

words.example: An antiseptic is used on skin, not on tools.
words.exampleTranslation: 皮肤抗菌剂用在皮肤上，不用在工具上。

evidence.quote: Antiseptics (ant-ih-SEP-tiks) are chemical germicides formulated for use on skin
Never use an antiseptic to disinfect instruments or other surfaces.

words.example: A nonporous item has no holes and cannot soak up liquid.
words.exampleTranslation: 无孔的物品没有小孔，不会吸收液体。

evidence.quote: Nonporous items are made of a material that has no pores or openings and that cannot absorb liquids

words.example: A single-use item is used on one client, then thrown away.
words.exampleTranslation: 一次性用品只给一位顾客用，用完就丢掉。

evidence.quote: All single-use implements are used once on a client. They are then discarded

words.example: Under Standard Precautions, treat all blood and body fluids as possibly infectious.
words.exampleTranslation: 按照标准预防措施，要把所有血液和体液都当作可能有传染性。

evidence.quote: are guidelines published by the CDC that require the employer and employee to assume that any human blood and body fluids are potentially infectious

words.example: Sharp disposables go in a sharps box, not the regular trash.
words.exampleTranslation: 一次性尖锐物品要放进锐器盒，不能丢进普通垃圾桶。

evidence.quote: Deposit sharp disposables in a sharps box.
all of these items (except sharps) may go into the regular trash

words.example: A Safety Data Sheet tells you a product's hazards and first aid.
words.exampleTranslation: 安全数据表会告诉你产品有哪些危害，以及怎样急救。

evidence.quote: List all hazards associated with the product
First-Aid Measures: Includes short- and long-term symptoms and first-aid instructions.

words.example: The Hazard Communication Standard says workers must be told about dangerous chemicals.
words.exampleTranslation: 危害沟通标准规定，必须告知员工有哪些危险化学品。

evidence.quote: The OSHA Hazard Communication Standard requires that employees be notified of any chemical in their workplace that could be hazardous.

words.example: An oxidizer, like hydrogen peroxide, gives off oxygen.
words.exampleTranslation: 氧化剂（例如双氧水）会释放氧气。

evidence.quote: An oxidizing agent (ahk-sih-DY-zing AY-jent) is a substance that releases oxygen.
an oxidizer such as hydrogen peroxide mixed with a flammable solvent such as acetone results in fire

words.example: Acetone is flammable: it catches fire easily.
words.exampleTranslation: 丙酮是易燃的：它很容易着火。

evidence.quote: a flammable solvent such as acetone
flammable (FLA-ma-bul) material is even easier to ignite

words.example: Combustible liquids can burn, but flammable ones catch fire more easily.
words.exampleTranslation: 可燃液体能燃烧，但易燃液体更容易着火。

evidence.quote: Combustible (kum-BUS-tah-bul) material is capable of igniting and burning. Compared to this, flammable (FLA-ma-bul) material is even easier to ignite

words.example: A spray bottle of mixed concentrate is a secondary container.
words.exampleTranslation: 装着兑好的浓缩液的喷瓶就是二次容器。

evidence.quote: When concentrates are mixed and used in a secondary container, such as a spray bottle, that container should be labeled

words.example: When a product irritates the skin, it is irritant contact dermatitis.
words.exampleTranslation: 产品刺激皮肤引起的皮炎，叫刺激性接触性皮炎。

evidence.quote: When the skin is irritated by a substance, it is called irritant contact dermatitis

words.example: Sensitization means the skin becomes much more allergic to a product.
words.exampleTranslation: 致敏是指皮肤对某种产品的过敏反应大大增强。

evidence.quote: A greatly increased or exaggerated allergic sensitivity to products.
With each exposure during a service, the risk of skin sensitization

words.example: Source-capture ventilation removes vapors and dust before they spread into the salon.
words.exampleTranslation: 源头捕集通风会在蒸气和粉尘散到店里之前把它们排走。

evidence.quote: These systems are designed to capture vapors and dusts at the source and remove them from the air before they have a chance to escape into the salon.

words.example: Wear nitrile gloves, not latex; latex allergies are common.
words.exampleTranslation: 要戴丁腈手套，不戴乳胶手套，因为对乳胶过敏的人很多。

evidence.quote: you should avoid latex due to increasingly common allergies to the material
Nitrile gloves are a strong alternative in both instances.

words.example: Ergonomics is setting up your work so your body moves safely.
words.exampleTranslation: 人体工学就是合理安排工作，让身体动起来更安全。

evidence.quote: is the science of designing the workplace as well as its equipment and tools to make specific body movements more comfortable, efficient, and safe.

words.example: Use hand sanitizer only when you cannot wash your hands.
words.exampleTranslation: 只有在无法洗手时，才用免洗洗手液。

evidence.quote: they are to be used only when water is not available for hand washing
they are an excellent option when hand washing is not possible

words.example: Staphylococci grow in clusters and can cause boils.
words.exampleTranslation: 葡萄球菌成簇生长，会引起疖子。

evidence.quote: pus-forming bacteria that grow in clusters like a bunch of grapes; cause abscesses, pustules, and boils

words.example: A pimple is a local infection.
words.exampleTranslation: 痘痘是一种局部感染。

evidence.quote: A local infection (LOKE-uhl in-FEK-shun), such as a pimple or abscess

words.example: A systemic infection spreads through the whole body.
words.exampleTranslation: 全身性感染会扩散到全身。

evidence.quote: is an infection where the pathogen has spread throughout the body rather than staying in one area or organ.

words.example: Quats usually disinfect implements in 10 minutes.
words.exampleTranslation: 季铵盐消毒剂通常 10 分钟就能给工具消毒。

evidence.quote: Quat solutions usually disinfect implements in 10 minutes.

words.example: Use a clean spatula to take cream from a jar.
words.exampleTranslation: 用干净的刮勺从罐子里取乳霜。

evidence.quote: For products in a tub-type container, always use a clean spatula (disposable or disinfectable) to remove the product

words.example: Touching a client's blood at work is an exposure incident.
words.exampleTranslation: 工作时碰到客人的血，就是暴露事件。

evidence.quote: is contact with non-intact (broken) skin, blood, body fluid, or other potentially infectious materials that is the result of the performance of a worker’s duties.

words.example: Carpal tunnel syndrome is a wrist injury.
words.exampleTranslation: 腕管综合征是一种手腕损伤。

evidence.quote: musculoskeletal disorders, including carpal tunnel syndrome (a wrist injury) and back injuries.

meaning.en: removes visible dirt with soap and water
meaning.zh: 用肥皂和水去掉看得见的污垢

meaning.en: kills most germs, but not bacterial spores
meaning.zh: 杀死大多数病菌，但杀不死细菌芽孢

meaning.en: kills all germs, even bacterial spores
meaning.zh: 杀死所有微生物，连细菌芽孢也杀死

tip.en: Three steps up: clean, then disinfect, then sterilize. Each step gets rid of more germs. Only sterilizing kills spores.
tip.zh: 三级台阶：清洁 → 消毒 → 灭菌，一级比一级去掉更多病菌。只有灭菌（sterilizing）能杀死芽孢。

evidence.quote: Cleaning is a mechanical process using soap and water or detergent and water to remove all visible dirt, debris, and many disease-causing germs.
specific products to destroy harmful organisms including bacteria, viruses and fungi (except bacterial spores)
Sterilizing is the process that destroys all microbial life, including spores

tip.en: Non = no. Nonpathogenic: no disease, like yogurt bacteria. Pathogenic: can make you sick.
tip.zh: non = 不。看中文：非致病性 = “非”（不）+ 致病，不会让人生病，比如做酸奶的细菌。致病性 = 会让人生病。

evidence.quote: Pathogenic (path-uh-JEN-ik) bacteria are harmful microorganisms that can cause disease or infection in humans
they are harmless organisms that may perform useful functions. They are safe to come in contact with since they do not cause disease or harm.
nonpathogenic organisms are used to make yogurt, cheese, and some medicines

tip.en: -cidal = kills. Read the start: bacteri- is bacteria, fungi- is fungi, viru- is virus.
tip.zh: -cidal = 杀。看开头：bacteri- 细菌，fungi- 真菌，viru- 病毒。中文也一样：杀细菌、杀真菌、杀病毒。

evidence.quote: bactericidal (bak-TEER-uh-SYD-uhl), capable of destroying bacteria
virucidal (viy-ruh-SYD-uhl), capable of destroying viruses
fungicidal (fun-ji-SYD-uhl), capable of destroying molds and fungi.

meaning.en: used on one client, then thrown away
meaning.zh: 只给一位顾客用，用完就丢

tip.en: Single = one: one client, then the trash. Multi = many: clean it, disinfect it, use it again.
tip.zh: single = 一个：一位顾客用完就丢（一次性）。multi = 很多：清洁、消毒后可以再用（可重复使用）。

evidence.quote: All single-use implements are used once on a client. They are then discarded
multiuse refers to items that can be cleaned, disinfected, and used on more than one person

meaning.en: germ killer made for use on skin
meaning.zh: 专门用在皮肤上的杀菌剂

meaning.en: for tools and hard surfaces, never skin
meaning.zh: 用在工具和坚硬表面上，绝不用在皮肤上

tip.en: Antiseptic goes with the bandage, on skin. Disinfectant goes on tools and tables, never on skin.
tip.zh: antiseptic 和创可贴一起用，用在皮肤上。disinfectant 用在工具和台面上，绝不用在皮肤上。看中文：“皮肤抗菌剂”名字里就有“皮肤”。

evidence.quote: Antiseptics (ant-ih-SEP-tiks) are chemical germicides formulated for use on skin
Offer your client antiseptic and an adhesive bandage.
Disinfectants are not for use on human skin, hair, or nails.
Use disinfectants only on clean, hard, nonporous surfaces.

meaning.en: liquid with a flash point below 100°F
liquid with a flash point of 100–200°F
meaning.zh: 闪点在 100°F 到 200°F 之间的液体

tip.en: Flammable starts like "flame": it catches fire more easily, below 100°F. Combustible needs more heat: 100–200°F.
tip.zh: flammable 开头像 flame（火焰）：更容易着火，闪点低于 100°F。combustible 要更热才着：100–200°F。看中文：“易燃”= 容易燃，“可燃”= 能燃。

evidence.quote: combustible liquid has a flash point between 100 and 200 degrees Fahrenheit, while flammable liquid has a flash point below 100 degrees
